sections.heading: C — Knowledge dossier: Noncommercial permits and examinations
sections.markdown:
## C — Knowledge dossier: Noncommercial permits and examinations

FACT_ID: sec03-F01 | anchor: A08
To obtain the instruction permit described for applicants under 18, the applicant must be at least 14 and pass both the vision and knowledge tests. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F02 | anchor: A08
The instruction permit for an applicant under 18 expires after 5 years or when the valid United States-presence documents expire, whichever comes first. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F03 | anchor: A08
An instruction-permit holder aged 14 through 17 ordinarily must keep the permit valid continuously for 275 days before upgrading to a restricted minor permit or operator license. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F04 | anchor: A08
The minor’s instruction-permit holding period becomes 180 days after completing a Department of Education-approved driver-education course with at least 80 percent on both its written and driving portions. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F05 | anchor: A08
A minor instruction-permit holder must drive with a parent or legal guardian, or another adult holding a valid license and at least 1 year of driving experience. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F06 | anchor: A08
The adult supervising an instruction-permit holder must sit in the seat next to the driver. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F07 | anchor: A08
A minor instruction-permit driver must complete 50 hours of adult-supervised driving, including 10 hours in inclement weather and 10 hours after dark. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F08 | anchor: A08
For the instruction-permit route headed Over 18, applicants must pass the vision and knowledge tests. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F09 | anchor: A08
The permit in the handbook’s Over 18 route lasts 5 years or until the valid United States-presence documents expire, whichever is earlier. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F10 | anchor: A08
A permit holder on the handbook’s Over 18 route must pass a drive test before upgrading to an operator license. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F11 | anchor: A08
The adult supervising the handbook’s Over 18 instruction-permit driver must have a valid driver license and at least 1 year of driving experience. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F12 | anchor: A08
Instruction-permit holders cannot use a wireless communication device while driving a motor vehicle on public roads. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F13 | anchor: A08
For permit restrictions, a wireless communication device means wireless electronic equipment that provides voice or data communication between at least 2 parties. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F14 | anchor: A08
The permit-related wireless-device definition includes cellular phones, texting devices, message-capable personal digital assistants, message-capable audio-video players and laptop computers. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F15 | anchor: A08
A restricted minor permit applicant must be at least 14, complete the instruction-permit requirements, pass the drive test and have no traffic-violation conviction during the preceding 6 months. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F16 | anchor: A08
The handbook allows an individual up to age 18 to hold a restricted minor permit. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F17 | anchor: A08
A restricted minor permit lasts 5 years or until the valid United States-presence documents expire, whichever happens first. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F18 | anchor: A08
From 6 a.m. to 10 p.m., a restricted minor permit holder may drive with the parent’s or guardian’s permission while carrying the permit in immediate physical possession. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F19 | anchor: A08
Between 10 p.m. and 6 a.m., the ordinary restricted-minor rule requires a parent or legal guardian seated next to the driver. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F20 | anchor: A08
A restricted minor permit must be used for at least 6 months. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F21 | anchor: A08
During the first 6 months on a restricted minor permit, passengers are limited to immediate family or household members. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F22 | anchor: A08
A restricted minor permit converts automatically to an operator license when its holder reaches 18. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F23 | anchor: A08
After 10 p.m., a restricted minor permit holder may drive alone on the most direct route to or from school, a school event, church, a church event or work, and the handbook also lists unregistered agricultural machinery and farm-related work. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F24 | anchor: A08
Restricted minor permit holders cannot use wireless communication devices while operating a motor vehicle on public roads. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F25 | anchor: A08
An operator-license applicant must be at least 16 and have passed the vision, knowledge and driving tests. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F26 | anchor: A08
An operator-license applicant aged 16 or 17 must satisfy the applicable instruction-permit or restricted-minor-permit requirements and have no traffic-violation conviction in the previous 6 months. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F27 | anchor: A08
An operator license lasts 5 years or until the valid United States-presence documents expire, whichever comes first. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-F28 | anchor: A08
The handbook’s printed prices list $38 each for the under-18 instruction permit, the Over 18 instruction permit, the restricted minor permit and the operator license. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0008]

Misconceptions: The shorter instruction-permit holding period depends on the cited approved driver-education performance; it is not the official knowledge-exam passing standard. Nighttime exceptions do not erase passenger restrictions.
Mnemonics: Use credential, age, supervisor, time and upgrade as an authored checklist, without adding an eligibility requirement.
Glossary: An instruction permit requires supervision; a restricted minor permit has its own permission, night and passenger conditions; an operator license has separate prerequisites.
Dynamic facts: Quoted fees and printed scheduling arrangements require issuer refresh; exam score, count and duration remain unknown.

ranked.label: Pedagogic emphasis: Preserve permit age, supervision, upgrade, night and passenger conditions.

items.why: Permit restrictions and examination procedures need distinct scenarios for each applicant route.

corpus_stability.reason: The official dated snapshot is pinned, but revision frequency has not been measured. Unknown cadence remains blocked for release pending the section-A verification debt; this is not a claim that the handbook is volatile.
